2609.24357.title: Mitigating Entity Type Confusion in Cross-Domain NER via Multidimensional Quantification and Reasoning Enhancement
2609.24357.paper_summary: Cross-domain Named Entity Recognition (CD-NER) aims to transfer the rich knowledge in the source domain to the target domain. Recent studies adopting decomposition or generation paradigms have achieved significant performance improvements, demonstrating high accuracy in entity span detection. However, during entity type classification, models severely suffer from entity type confusion, the erroneous tendency that models classify entities of one type in the text as another similar but incorrect type. To address this issue, we first propose a Multidimensional Confusion Quantification Model (MCQM) that quantifies a model's confusion extent between entity types from three dimensions: source-target hierarchy analysis, semantic similarity analysis, and explicit data evaluation. Moreover, we propose the Progressive Bidirectional Reasoning Chain (PBRC). PBRC leverages the source-target hierarchy and confusion analysis from the MCQM to prompt the LLM to generate two-stage reasoning information. The two-stage reasoning information is utilized to augment the knowledge of the model, significantly mitigating entity type confusion and improving the model's generalization performance. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves new state-of-the-art results on all domains of the CrossNER dataset.
2609.24357.paper_summary_zh: 跨域命名實體識別（CD-NER）旨在將來源域中的豐富知識轉移到目標域。<lb/>最近採用分解或生成範式的研究已實現顯著的性能提升，顯示出在實體範圍檢測中的高準確性。<lb/>然而，在實體類型分類過程中，模型嚴重遭受實體類型混淆的問題，即模型將文本中一種類型的實體錯誤地分類為另一種相似但不正確的類型。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們首先提出了一種多維混淆量化模型（MCQM），該模型從三個維度量化模型在實體類型之間的混淆程度：來源-目標層級分析、語義相似性分析和明確數據評估。<lb/>此外，我們提出了漸進式雙向推理鏈（PBRC）。<lb/>PBRC利用MCQM中的來源-目標層級和混淆分析，促使大型語言模型（LLM）生成兩階段推理信息。<lb/>這兩階段的推理信息用於增強模型的知識，顯著減輕實體類型混淆並改善模型的泛化性能。<lb/>實驗結果表明，我們的方法在CrossNER數據集的所有領域上達到了新的最先進結果。
